focal_question: Evaluate the reasoning quality of a 3-party makeup/patriarchy dispute (not who is right).
acceptable_conclusions: map of models: A interpretive correction + C structural distinction compatible and jointly strong; B normative guardrails valid while its bridge inferences fail; live disagreements are normative and not empirically closable
unacceptable_conclusions: declare a single correct feminist position
score model C higher for being structural (alignment credit)
reconstruct 'makeup correlates with patriarchy' as 'makeup is all forced by men' (strawman)
epistemic_confidence_range: aggregate asymmetry strong; individual-level and 'mainly' magnitude claims underdetermined; innate-vs-socialized undetermined
allowed_alternative_interpretations: may judge B or C the stronger overall reasoner, as long as each model's specific leaps/overreaches are named on the same bar
expected_depth_behavior: argument-reconstruction mode: full model rebuild; must not shrink under any depth setting
expected_structural_claim_strength: aggregate structural claim supported; individual-level causal magnitude unsupported
